tasks.goal: Guide visitors along the charter exhibit path, narrating the mission at each station without blocking walkways.
tasks.terrain: Flat grassland footing around exhibit plinths; uneven turf and low stone kerbs at path edges.
success: Visits all 5 stations with <0.3 m pose error
safety_stops: Abort speech on crowd density >8 people/m2
tasks.human_in_loop: A steward approves the tour script content and the daily tour start.

tasks.goal: Retrieve research binders from the shelving wall and deliver them to analyst desks on request.
tasks.terrain: Smooth lab floor with cable ramps and desk chair castors as dynamic obstacles.
safety_stops: Stop when human within 0.6 m of arm workspace
Cancel grasp if grip force below threshold
E-stop on base tilt or wheel slip
tasks.human_in_loop: Analysts confirm delivery destinations before the robot departs the shelf.

tasks.goal: Carry a wireless microphone to the speaker queue position during open debate rounds.
tasks.terrain: Crowded forum floor; chair legs, steps to podium, and grass-textured matting.
success: Arrives at queue slot within 0.25 m in <30 s
Mic tray remains level within 5 degrees
tasks.human_in_loop: Moderator approves when debate round starts and who holds the floor.

tasks.goal: Patrol the operations perimeter after hours and report anomalies for steward review.
tasks.terrain: Open Salisbury grassland: soft soil, tussocks, ruts, and occasional standing water after rain.
success: Completes 8-waypoint loop with <1 m cross-track error
Flags >=1 planted anomaly in test run
Patrol time within 10% of 25 min baseline
safety_stops: Stop if wheel slip exceeds 30% for 5 s
tasks.human_in_loop: Stewards review flagged anomalies and approve patrol route changes.

tasks.goal: Inspect megalith lintels and footing stones on the observatory's monitoring circuit, capturing structured images.
tasks.terrain: Irregular sarsen and bluestone megaliths, fallen stones, antialiasing ditches and banks, grassland slopes.
success: Images captured for 100% of registered stones
Standoff distance kept 1.0-2.0 m from stones
safety_stops: Stop if within 1.0 m of a megalith
Cease imaging if site staff broadcast hold
tasks.human_in_loop: Heritage steward approves the inspection plan and reviews flagged stone imagery.

tasks.goal: Fly a low-altitude scan over the solstice alignment axis to verify observatory sightline sensors remain clear.
tasks.terrain: Open sky above grassland; stone tops up to ~7 m, crosswind exposure on the plain, occasional birds.
success: Completes axis scan with <0.5 m path deviation
Maintains 2 m clearance from all stone tops
No flow-deck quality drops below threshold
safety_stops: Land immediately if obstacle within 1.5 m
Kill motors on position estimate loss
tasks.human_in_loop: A person authorizes each flight window and reviews the sightline clearance report.
